body:
Resolve all 16 accepted Round 1 adversarial-review-loop findings (ARB-001..ARB-016):
1. Archive base ticket t-fix-review-loop-dd0310f and mark T-FACTORY-1..7 completed so .adlc/tickets/ passes scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs.
2. Add agb_shape and agb_init to BOOSTER_MCP_TOOLS in hooks/policy/constants.mjs and enforce workerTicket and readonly confinement in hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs evaluateMcpTool.
3. Fix scripts/sync-models.mjs bundled CLI guard, rootDir defaults, and agyModelsStdout PTY probing.
4. Enforce symlink/physical containment checks across cleanOldLogs, ownerOnlyDir, runInit, applyDoctorFixes, and writeArtifactFileAtomically; bootstrap securityMode unsigned-fallback in .adlc/config.json; return boolean from ensureGitignore.
5. Fix scripts/run-tests.mjs coverage aggregation (--test without single quotes across discovered suite files).
6. Clear setInterval timer and handle SIGINT/SIGTERM in watchStatus(), and forward compact in renderStatus().
7. Harden isTemporaryOrWorldWritablePath in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs (/dev/shm, /run/shm, /var/lock, /run/lock and strict ancestor check above homedir) and restore evals/baseline.json.
8. Fix selectLensModel PoolSet fallback, reviewPlan quota/loop deduplication, triageFindings ID reconciliation and gateVerdict logic, and <<UNTRUSTED:...>> prompt wrapping in lib/review.mjs and lib/plan.mjs.
9. Align skills/**, commands/**, website/content/docs/**, website/env-docs.json, bin/agb.mjs, and mcp/server.mjs with real CLI/MCP contracts.
10. Fix decomposeTickets sibling rail overlap check, bin/agb.mjs maxTicketScope default, readBrain non-shadowing of implementation_plan.md, TerminalHUD log routing in lib/scheduler.mjs, safeExtractJson fence/candidate parsing in lib/json.mjs, remote URL credential scrubbing in bin/agb.mjs, parseStructuredSpec/scanStaticImportCoupling in lib/shape.mjs, remove zero-caller dead exports, rebuild dist/, regenerate website/generated/, and expand regression tests.
title: Resolve Round 1 adversarial-review-loop findings across Factory Parity surface
